narrative_purpose: The dim, immersive mood layer the chapter's text floats over: the hidden underground of a forest, a vast dark soil column threaded with the faintest glow of fungal cabling, so wide and atmospheric that no single subject competes with the prose — a sense of a whole buried network breathing beneath the world.
subject: An ultra-wide subterranean vista: a deep cross-section of forest soil seen as if from within the earth, the dark loam threaded everywhere with the faintest filaments of bioluminescent mycelium fanning out and interlacing, the underside of great tree roots descending from the top of the frame into the gloom, everything dissolving into deep haze.
scene: Below the soil line, layered depths of dark earth receding into atmospheric murk, a few root masses descending from above, the mycelial threads faint and scattered like distant constellations underground.
camera: An ultra-wide panoramic view through the soil, everything small, deep, and atmospheric.
light: Very low-key: faint cool bioluminescent speckle from the mycelial threads, deep shadow everywhere else; deliberately dark and low-contrast so overlaid text stays legible.
palette: Dominant void-indigo and deep teal-indigo, only the faintest threads of Pandora cyan and living teal glow, almost no warm accent.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, atmospheric, soft, detail dissolving into haze.
detail_level: Low overall — no crisp focal subject; everything soft, distant, and dim, dissolving into atmospheric depth.
composition: Wide horizontal mood field with deep haze, no bright focal point, generous dark expanses across the whole frame for text overlay.
consistency_notes: Macro establishing mood for this chapter; dark, low-contrast, immersive; same cool Pandora palette and from-within glow as the chapter cover but far dimmer and wider.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style, no bright central subject
